notes.title: utm_source appears 2 times
notes.detail: The URL already carries more than one utm_source, and analytics tools disagree about which one counts. Type a value here to leave exactly one.

notes.title: Capital letters in utm_campaign
notes.detail: Most analytics tools are case-sensitive, so “Fall Sale+” and “fall sale+” are reported as two different campaigns. Lowercase keeps them together.

notes.title: A + in utm_campaign
notes.detail: A + typed here is a literal plus, encoded as %2B, and reports show it as one. For a space, type a space; for a separator, a dash.

notes.title: Spaces in utm_campaign
notes.detail: Each space is written %20 in the URL and comes back as a space in reports. It works; dashes read better in both places.
